chat.ch.name: Display name
chat.ch.probe.fail: Could not fetch. Check the access token and try again.
chat.ch.probe.mismatch: This token belongs to a different OA than the account being edited — saving will move the page (existing conversations move with it):
chat.ch.probe.notdeployed: The chat service does not have this endpoint yet — restart triple_sale_chat first (not an access token problem).
chat.ch.g.LINE: Use the Channel Secret and Channel access token from LINE Developers Console (Messaging API tab). Paste the access token and press fetch - the Page ID, name and picture are filled in.
chat.ch.g.FACEBOOK: Use the Page access token of the page (Meta App Dashboard > Messenger > API Setup). Paste it and press fetch - the Page ID, name and picture are filled in. Each page uses its own token.
chat.ch.g.INSTAGRAM: Use the Page access token of the Facebook page linked to the Instagram business account. Press fetch and the Instagram account ID is filled in (it is not the Page ID of the page).
chat.ch.g.WHATSAPP: Use the Phone number ID and access token of WhatsApp Business (Meta App Dashboard > WhatsApp > API Setup). Replies are allowed within 24 hours after the last customer message.
chat.ch.g.TIKTOK: Requires an app in TikTok for Business Developers approved for Business Messaging. Enter the App ID and App Secret, then follow the connect steps below. Replies are allowed within 48 hours - text and images only.
chat.ch.probe.h.token: Paste the access token and press this button - the account ID, name and picture are filled in.
chat.ch.probe.h.id: Enter the account ID in the field below first, then press this button to check the token and fill in the name.
chat.ch.probe.h.tiktok: Checks a token you pasted yourself - not needed after the connect steps above.
chat.ch.probe.mismatch2: This token belongs to a different account than the one being edited - saving will move the account (existing chats follow):
chat.ch.secret.opt: Optional - the server-wide App Secret is used. Fill it in only when this account belongs to a different Meta app.
chat.ch.hook.title: Set up on the {0} side
chat.ch.hook.s.LINE: Paste the Webhook URL at LINE Developers Console > Messaging API > Webhook settings, turn on Use webhook and set the OA response mode to Bot.
chat.ch.hook.s.FACEBOOK: At Meta App Dashboard > Messenger > Webhooks paste the Callback URL and Verify Token, select the messages event, then subscribe this page.
chat.ch.hook.s.INSTAGRAM: At Meta App Dashboard > Instagram > Webhooks paste the Callback URL and Verify Token, select the messages event, and allow access to messages in the Instagram app of the account.
chat.ch.hook.s.WHATSAPP: At Meta App Dashboard > WhatsApp > Configuration paste the Callback URL and Verify Token, then subscribe to the messages event.
chat.ch.hook.s.TIKTOK: Register the Redirect URI below in the TikTok app before authorizing. The Webhook URL is registered with TikTok automatically when you connect.
chat.ch.hook.noverify: The server administrator has not set the Verify Token yet (WEBHOOK_META_VERIFY_TOKEN)
chat.ch.hook.notpublic: This address is not a public https address, so providers cannot reach it - ask the administrator to set APP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
chat.ch.hook.sig: This server verifies webhook signatures - the {0} must match the provider side or messages are rejected

label.ad.terms_title: Rights of the Parties under This Vehicle Booking Agreement
label.ad.terms_1: 10.1 Rights of the booker: The booker may terminate this agreement if any of the following occurs
label.ad.terms_2: 10.1.1 The booking recipient raises the vehicle price
label.ad.terms_3: 10.1.2 The booking recipient fails to deliver the vehicle within the specified period
label.ad.terms_4: 10.1.3 The booking recipient fails to deliver a vehicle whose brand, model, model year, color and engine size match this agreement
label.ad.terms_5: 10.1.4 The booking recipient fails to deliver the vehicle with the additional accessories, free gifts or other benefits specified in this agreement
label.ad.terms_6: 10.1.5 The booker is not granted the requested credit within the period in which the booking recipient must deliver the vehicle. Upon termination as described above, the booking recipient will refund the deposit to the booker within 15 days from the termination date
label.ad.terms_7: However, the booker may choose not to terminate and instead agree otherwise with the booking recipient in writing
label.ad.terms_8: 10.2 Rights of the booking recipient (the Company): The booking recipient may terminate this agreement in the following cases
label.ad.terms_9: 10.2.1 If the booking recipient learns that the booker applied for vehicle credit and the credit was not approved within the delivery period, in which case the booking recipient will refund the deposit within 15 days from the termination date
label.ad.terms_10: 10.2.2 If the booker breaches this agreement by not taking delivery within the agreed period after being notified, the booking recipient may retain the deposit
label.ad.foot_b: a receipt. The booker may request a receipt from the company only.
